title: rness policy front matter
description: The YAML front matter of a policy of .rness/policy/ (policy/<name>.md or policy/<scope>/<name>.md), contract 1. The title is the document's '# ' heading and its body the reason; neither is in the front matter. rness validate checks this by hand and refuses more than a schema can say: a 'deny' pattern that does not compile as a JavaScript regular expression with the flags iu, a 'standard' that does not exist in the workspace, a file name that is not lowercase words joined by hyphens, a name both global and scoped, and YAML beyond 1.2 core (anchors, aliases, custom tags, merge keys, duplicate keys). Values that are names or patterns are strings: quote 3.10 or no.

status.description: Enabled: in the block, applied by the guard and the git hooks. Disabled: listed and validated, applied nowhere.

rules.description: What the policy refuses, one rule or more.

standard.description: The .rness-relative path of an existing standard that explains the rule.

date.description: An ISO date, as on other documents.

updated.description: An ISO date, as on other documents.

check.description: commit-message: each line of the commit message. added-lines: each line a commit or an edit adds. push: each ref update of a push.

deny.description: A JavaScript regular expression, compiled with the flags iu and matched against one line at a time; for a push rule, non-fast-forward.

fix.description: One line: what the agent reads when refused.
